baseline_prompt: Photorealistic clinical dental photography of healthy teeth without visible decay.
mild: Photorealistic clinical dental photography of mild dental caries, slight localized discoloration and early tooth decay.
moderate: Photorealistic clinical dental photography of moderate dental caries, clearly visible brown decay and cavity-like damage on visible teeth.
severe: Photorealistic clinical dental photography of severe dental caries, extensive dark decay and obviously damaged tooth surface.
